facts.label: Note
facts.value: Qianlong's east dike (S02 p.109 quotes the 1750 stele on 'the great east dike'; zh.wiki says the 东堤 was built with the Guangxu wall: disagreement) and west dike with its bridges; 南湖岛 and the 十七孔桥. Open to the public in Qianlong's time and until the Guangxu wall (S02 p.199). Today's 团城湖 (osm relation 68324) and 团城湖调节池 are modern water works (C for 1860). Overlaps the water topic.; Pictures: S1210 (十七孔桥 with lotus, 1860), S1211 (panorama after the fire). Also: osm relation 2308772: today's lake north part; the outline holds since 1750 (no later re-dig of the main basin known); the OSM relation stops at 39.989, the southern basin is not in it (Kunming Lake (清漪园)), 0 m from the point used. Also: LoC Beijing cheng jiao tu c.1886 read at px 6969,3391, fit rms 226 m, 832 m from the point used.
